mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI SEO efforts for accountants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seeing results from AI SEO efforts typically takes several months, similar to traditional SEO. Initial improvements in search rankings and website traffic might be observed within 3-6 months. However, significant and sustained growth, especially for competitive accounting keywords, often requires 6-12 months or longer. Factors like current website authority, competition, and the consistency of optimization efforts influence the timeline. AI tools can accelerate certain processes and provide quicker insights, but algorithm changes and content indexing still require time.
